hypothesis: Within a fixed Top-50, combining frozen DPR Reader relevance with localized span confidence and boundary concentration can recover useful passages that relevance alone ranks low; a shallow entangling score interaction may encode these joint Reader signals while a separate redundancy-aware greedy ablation reduces near-duplicate competition.
online_features: passage title/text only for token-Jaccard redundancy

feature_normalization.method: population z-score, clip to [-3,3], divide by 3

methods.answer_scorer_topk: descending raw relevance_logit; must exactly match stored topk_common_order
methods.qore_answer_scorer: stored qore_common_order on the same fixed candidate set
methods.classical_matched_born: independent parity-polynomial evaluation of the exact same Born expectations; must match the statevector score within 1e-10

redundancy_ablation.selection: greedy Top-5 over min-max normalized base scores minus penalty times maximum Jaccard with selected passages
redundancy_ablation.tokenization: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric tokens with apostrophe-preserving words

posthoc_only: per-question paired comparisons and bootstrap intervals
controls: matched redundancy penalty on classical and quantum score arms

gates.advance_signal_mechanism_only_if: a span-feature arm exceeds both stored baselines with paired 95% bootstrap lower bound above zero and no material redundancy regression
gates.quantum_advantage_claim: not tested; fixed circuit has zero trainable parameters and exact classical parity is required

exchange_downloads: fixed 100-case detail JSON when absent from the checkout
exchange_uploads: score_trace.json and sample_trace.json when each exceeds the 1 MiB GitHub threshold
